name: Super Sushi Samurai stale-balance self-transfer inflation
summary: The token's custom _update() read the recipient balance before reducing the sender balance. When sender and recipient were equal, its final recipient write overwrote the reduction with the stale balance plus the transfer amount, so every self-transfer minted the transferred amount out of nothing. The first exercise, on 2024-03-17, was a self-transfer of an entire 272,222,222,222.22195 SSS balance whose minted duplicate was sold into the SSS/WETH pair two minutes later; from 2024-03-21 game players, a whitehat that emptied the pair, and two later actors who self-transferred the pair's own balance through skim() repeated it.

loss.notes: Four campaigns against pair 0x92f32553cc465583d432846955198f0ddcbcafa1 (token0 WETH, UniswapV2-style 0.3% fee) are merged. (1) 2024-03-17 first exercise: 0x3dd45687042335a753e69f930ee0a5c3d6d01235 self-transferred its whole 272,222,222,222.22195 SSS balance (anchor), which minted an equal duplicate, then sold its entire 7,621,950,000,000.2146 SSS balance in 0xd576deeed7619498d71a33eeae6bd22eb08790b7d134ca81e00757ad7d7f8071 for 28.384109665566404476 WETH. The component is the WETH attributable to the minted 272,222,222,222.22195 SSS: actual output minus the output the same swap gives for the balance without it (7,202,733,222,222.432797 SSS after the 2% sell tax) at the pre-swap reserves 762.343906020378814326 WETH / 192,568,090,897,129.908987 SSS, i.e. 28.384109665566404476 - 27.406800442796240454 = 0.977309222770164022 WETH; the 997/1000 formula reproduces the actual output to the wei. (2) 2024-03-21 whitehat campaign of 0x6a89a8c67b5066d59bf4d81d59f70c3976facd0a: it first paid 0.010000000000000000 WETH into the SSS/WETH pair, then the cash-out receipt transferred 1,310.040494988573740722 WETH from that pair with zero WETH returned. Gross victim depletion net of the linked input is therefore 1,310.040494988573740722 - 0.010000000000000000 = 1,310.030494988573740722 WETH. The cash-out also delivered 4,954,444,444,444,439 SSS to the pair, exactly matching its same-block archive increase; this unbacked consideration is retained by the victim and is not a second loss component. Other pair activity between the setup purchase and cash-out reduced pair WETH by 109.408357782325449417; it is not attributed to this campaign (see the incident limitation). (3) 2024-03-21 blackhat 0xd0203f15af5ccc7e22966b31ef7a37316b6fab56: one transaction from its freshly created contract 0x71f759457568b9c1e5010d5587bae20dc572e0a5 called pair.skim(pair) 72 times, each a pair-to-pair self-transfer that doubled the pair's SSS balance, and swapped the inflated balance out, netting 40.278322289118611961 WETH out of the pair (1 wei WETH input already deducted). (4) Four seconds later 0xc0ffeebabe5d496b2dde509f9fa189c25cf29671 repeated the same pair-balance route in seven transactions (blocks 1116275-1116297), netting 7.100269482163580044 WETH. The remaining 29.086743612218663948 WETH left the pair at block 1116976 as a liquidity removal by LP 0x2836ca71fd966aa08024869d0c6bb72ab55e93c9 and is not loss. Players who self-transferred from 2024-03-21 13:13 UTC (0x05f43bfe..., 0x82a95827..., 0x9b96c9ac..., 0xa875a98d..., 0x65db5f6b...) moved the inflated SSS into the game contract 0x3028ea87ba570f7e3b4ddb96da94f455fa8f400c or to other wallets and made no net pair WETH withdrawal of their own (0x82a95827 was a net 0.1 WETH buyer); the 129 other transaction senders that first self-transferred after the whitehat drain likewise withdrew no pair WETH. ETH prices: 3,627.08 USD 143 s before campaign 1's sale, 3,526.16 USD for campaign 2 as before, 3,496.9 USD 153 s before campaign 3. The later 1,244.66 WETH whitehat return is recovery and is not netted.

ageReset.description: The stale-balance _update logic is part of the token's immutable direct runtime, deployed in this transaction and unchanged through the exploit.

sources.note: Archive-RPC review bounded one linked whitehat campaign. Sender nonce 0 bought SSS with exactly 0.01 WETH; nonce 1 created the helper; nonce 2 moved the purchased SSS into it; nonce 3 and the recipient's return transaction establish custody linkage; nonce 4 made the first defective self-transfer calls; nonce 5 cashed out the pair; and nonce 6 moved the WETH to the linked recipient. Pair WETH was 1,448.948886786028391015 before the setup purchase, 1,448.958886786028391015 after it, 1,339.550529003702941598 immediately before cash-out, and 29.510034015129200876 after cash-out. Thus the receipt's ten WETH outflows exactly explain the 1,310.040494988573740722 same-block archive delta; the intervening 109.408357782325449417-WETH market decline is unrelated and excluded. Pair SSS increased by exactly the receipt's 4,954,444,444,444,439-SSS input during cash-out. The helper then transferred the WETH to the linked recipient; a later 1,244.66-WETH return is recovery, while the separate 40.28-WETH blackhat campaign uses a different actor and is excluded. The first defect receipt is 48 seconds before cash-out, so it remains the incident anchor. The SSS token is a direct contract created at 570927:3; code is absent at 570926 and the 11,280-byte runtime hash 0xa8fff26c4cd91901e875f739abd473d6374ebb996cd92e317131b892ecbb0e2e is unchanged at the incident, with no delegation or destruction path. Its age at the first defect is 1,080,976 seconds. DefiLlama's ETH observation at 1711032590 is 55 seconds before that anchor and 103 seconds before cash-out.

Re-anchored and merged the full campaign. Anchor completeness: eth_getLogs for Transfer on SSS 0xdfdcdbc789b56f99b0d0692d14dbc61906d9deed over [570927, 1111414] (41,330 logs) with topic1 == topic2 yields exactly 13 self-transfer transactions before the former anchor; the earliest is 0x05eb5605 at block 940338 index 2 (timestamp 1710690491, status 1), EOA 0x3dd45687042335a753e69f930ee0a5c3d6d01235 nonce 0 calling transfer(self, 272222222222221950000000000000). Verified source contracts/SSS.sol _update(): fromBalanceBeforeTransfer = _balances[from]; toBalance = _balances[to] + amountAfterTax; _balances[from] = fromBalanceBeforeTransfer - amount; _balances[to] = toBalance, so from == to nets +amount. balanceOf(0x3dd45687) = 272222222222221950000000000000 at block 940337 and 816666666666665850000000000000 at block 940338, whose only other transfer to it is index 3 (272222222222221950000000000000 from 0x1b62380cc5f88297e099f7c7d25d7f96466562c9), so the self-transfer alone doubled the balance. After 38 more identical inbound transfers the balance was 7621950000000214600000000000000 at block 940460 and 0 at 940461: source-10 (block 940461 index 1, router 0x98994a9a7a2570367554589189dc9772241650f6 selector 0x791ac947) sends 152439000000004292000000000000 tax to the token (sellTaxPercent 200 at block 940460) and 7469511000000210308000000000000 to the pair, receiving log 2 WETH 28384109665566404476. Pair Sync after the swap: reserve0 0x27c9bd02195aa2f7fa, reserve1 0x9dcd45a1226f269fdbcf30b4f56; pre-swap reserves are these +out / -in; amountOut = in*997*r0/(r1*1000+in*997) reproduces 28384109665566404476 exactly, and the same formula on the balance without the minted amount gives 27406800442796240454, so 977309222770164022 wei is attributable. Intent looks accidental (a consolidation wallet sending to itself first), but the transaction is the earliest successful exercise of the defect whose output was sold, so it anchors the incident; the first deliberate exercise would be 0xc837957228baa2e0a55e2d37199fc4c5b647ee20d953d06def22eea98cd5c40b (block 1108504) and the former anchor 0x80012bf7 (block 1111415). Campaign scope: pair WETH balanceOf reads 1451.38 (block 1110000), 1339.549 (1111438), 29.510 (1111439), 76.490 (1112000-1115000) and 0.0208 (1120000). All WETH Transfer logs from/to the pair over [1108000, 1120000] (918 out, 2098 in) were netted per transaction and attributed to eth_getTransactionByHash.from; of 1,431 self-transfer transactions over [570927, 1120000] (including 532 pair-to-pair skim transfers), 138 distinct transaction senders appear; the only ones with positive net pair WETH after their first self-transfer are exactly 0x6a89a8c6 (1310.040494988573740722 out in 0x62e6b906, less its 0.01 input in 0x4281343f), 0xd0203f15 (40.278322289118611961 in source-11, block 1116271 index 2, contract created at index 1; callTracer shows 72 pair.skim(pair) calls 0xbc25cf77 and 2 swaps 0x022c0d9f) and 0xc0ffeebabe (7.100269482163580044 across the seven source-12 transactions, nonces 1356-1368, the first with 70 skim calls). The 29.086743612218663948 WETH outflow at block 1116976 (0xcd7b5764..., 0x2836ca71fd966aa08024869d0c6bb72ab55e93c9 via router 0x98994a9a...) burns 380992854992787772096076738 pair LP tokens and is a liquidity removal. Pre-anchor self-transferrers from block 1108504 made no pair-WETH transaction; their inflated SSS went to game contract 0x3028ea87ba570f7e3b4ddb96da94f455fa8f400c or to other wallets. Runtime keccak of the token at block 940337 is 0xa8fff26c4cd91901e875f739abd473d6374ebb996cd92e317131b892ecbb0e2e, identical to the deployment-block hash in source-6, so age = 1710690491 - 1709951669 = 738,822 s. realizedAt = block 1116297 timestamp 1711042409.

limitations: Router sells by accounts that never self-transferred between 2024-03-21 13:13 UTC and the whitehat drain (pair WETH fell from 1451.38 at block 1110000 to 1339.55 at block 1111438) may include SSS that game players minted by self-transfer and passed on; that provenance is not traced, so the loss is a floor over the four exactly measured campaigns.

notes: Anchor moved from 0x80012bf784b83baaf28f5549a9f233cae5f70be7afcd8f594dc757d431ed93c4 (the whitehat's first self-transfer, block 1111415) to the earliest successful self-transfer 0x05eb560568717126a07c1ea71be7ab0f790ea5a7ad6071f4aa0edbd37d6720a0 (block 940338), whose minted SSS was sold into the pair; see source-15.
